title: The Land of Whim
description: We’re big fans of Betina Bożek’s brand of queasy brilliance (Oh God! LIFF32) and we’re excited to present her latest short. It’s another example of the whimsical freedom offered by the animated form. Sensuous, chaotic and deeply surreal, there is yet a liberating exuberance in a land where anything goes.
producers: Jan Matejko Academy of Fine Arts
sound: the great hand of fate is playing the tunes of our lives. But everyone needs a break once in a while. What is unexpected however
is the chaos and debauchery unleashed when a few small innocent interventions are made. An extreme satire on love
